warnings.message: Review the reconstructed PDF layout and colors. PDF viewers can display colors differently. Tables may become positioned shapes. Original form definitions are retained separately.
AcroForm definitions are retained. XFA, digital signatures and PDF scripts are not recreated. Scanned pages require a separate capability review.
Some document fonts use compatible SharePoint fonts.
Character spacing, raised text or case effects may differ in the SharePoint editor.
Positioned source content remains editable and grouped, but SharePoint reflows it in document order. Original drawing positions are retained in preview metadata.
This PDF contains images alongside editable text. Some pages or words may remain inside images; OCR is not included. Review every page for missing editable text before sending.
